fixed: Deleting your Default template no longer leaves Blank program as the default without saying so: the first template left in your list takes its place until you choose another, so New program and calendar-import drafts still start from a template. Undo of the delete gives the old default back.
Tapping New program twice quickly opens one builder (or one Start from a template sheet), not two.
Search marks an archived program Archived, on screen and to a screen reader, so it can be told from a live program with the same title.
In a program template's slots, the Move up, Move down, Edit and Delete buttons name the slot they act on to a screen reader, and moving a slot says where it landed.

In Perform's Swap this dance, a suggestion's reason names the saved venue the program is linked to, not the venue text typed on the program, and names each figure as the program matrix names its column.

added: ProgramRepository.archivedIds: the ids of the live programs that are archived.
